newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Jan-Aug PSBR at 70.3-70.8 trln lire -paper.
newsitem.headline: Italian Jan-Aug PSBR at 70.3-70.8 trln lire -paper.

text.p: In the first eight months of 1996, Italy's Public Sector Borrowing Requirement (PSBR) will total between 70.3 and 70.8 trillion lire, up from 67.482 trillion lire in the some period of 1995, Il Sole 24 Ore reported.
The article in the Milan financial daily paper did not give the source of its figures.
The paper said the PSBR was 8.5-9.0 trillion lire in August, compared with 11.306 trillion lire in August 1995.
The last official data from the Treasury was for the first five months, which put the PSBR at 76.486 trillion lire against 66.439 trillion a year ago.
The Treasury did not comment on the data given in the paper but said that within the week, it will publish the PSBR data for the January-July 1996 period.
